name: Load Balancer
description: A load balancer — also called an ALB/NLB/ELB, reverse proxy, traffic distributor, or HAProxy/Nginx front end — that spreads inbound connections across backend instances and often terminates TLS. A traffic chokepoint at the edge of a service tier. The place to look for the load balancer, ALB/NLB, traffic distribution layer, or the component fronting and balancing requests across backends.
